name: 会話に共有する準備リスト
prompt:
Generate one faithful, high-resolution mobile conversation-post screenshot matching the Japanese Lighthouse native preview. Keep the canvas ratio exactly 390:206 and show only this single post, with no Slack channel header, other messages, reactions, bottom navigation, or surrounding page.

Use the native preview as the authority for the exact Japanese copy, spacing, typography, and avatar treatment. At the top, show the small pale-mint circular avatar with the same simple initial, author 「山田 はるか」 in dark bold text, and time 「14:45」 in muted gray aligned to the right. Below, show the heading 「次の相談までに考えること」, then exactly four compact black bullet items:
・参考になる事例を集める
・どの方法で進めるか話し合う
・話し合いの流れを決める
・下書きを作成する

Preserve the native preview's compact white post surface, left alignment, Japanese line breaks, regular/bold Meiryo-like text hierarchy, and bullet spacing. The original Slack screenshot is only reference for the source checklist structure; do not copy its avatar photo, channel chrome, unread bubble, reactions, or English wording. This post has no hyperlink text, so add no blue text. Do not add pictures, cards, emoji, extra bullets, separators, shadows, or controls.
reviewNotes: 第1版を目視。作者・時刻・見出しと4項目全ての日本語を維持し、余計な画面要素はない。native previewに比べアバター/作者/見出し/箇条書き全体が約10px下に寄り、項目間の縦間隔も広い。needs-correctionで保持。所有者受入・ネイティブ編集・実動作は未検証。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。

inputReferences.role: Native Japanese preview: exact author, time, four bullets, spacing, avatar and canvas
Primary Slack source screenshot: checklist structure and post semantics; crop [15,458,375,614] in normalized-width-390 coordinates
